strategy_rules: Daily bet = strong 2-leg parlay when BOTH legs are High/Elite AND each leg >= 67% model win probability AND the best combo clears 52% combined probability
If no parlay clears that bar, bet the single best High/Elite pick instead (no forced weak parlays)
Leg selection picks the highest combined-probability pair from the top 5 qualifying legs — NOT blind top-2 rank
Validated walk-forward with real closing odds + $10 compound bankroll (45% parlay / 25% single stake):

parlay-only days: 66.7% hit (8-4) on 12 qualifying days; single fallback: 71.4% (32-16) on 48 days
